description: This file is a script for analyzing source code to identify specific API usage violations related to pairing store account scoping. It uses TypeScript compiler API to parse and traverse source files, checking for certain function call patterns and argument properties.

methods.name: isUndefinedLikeExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node represents the 'undefined' identifier or a null literal in the AST.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Checks if an object literal expression includes an 'accountId' property that is not undefined or null.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Parses a source file content, traverses the AST, and collects violations related to specific API call argument patterns.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script execution function that collects violations from source files and reports findings.
